title: Playboy Magazine June 1981 Cover: Terri Welles Playmate: Cathy Larmouth
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from June 1981, featuring Terri Welles on the cover and Cathy Larmouth as the Playmate. This edition showcases a mix of art, photography, and modeling content, typical of the magazine's genre. With a monthly publication frequency and a distribution method of paid circulation, this Playboy Magazine issue from 1981 offers a glimpse into the popular culture and lifestyle of the time, making it a collectible item for fans of vintage magazines.
